test_title: PYST 11: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 22 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option 'no correction required' if the sentence is correct as given.

(I were the only one that) could swim, so I made a dash for it.

options.text: I was that only one whom
I were the only one whom
I was the only one that

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the singular form of the verb 'were' is incorrect.
 
• In the given sentence, the subject ‘I’ is **singular** and requires the singular verb 'was'.
 
• Therefore, the correct form of the verb 'was' should be used in place of the plural form 'were'.

Hence, the correct statement is **"I was the only one that ** **could swim, so I made a dash for it."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In sentences where the subject is **singular**, the verb should also be **singular**.

 
 
• **Example:** ***She** **was** the only one who knew the answer*.
 
 
 
• In sentences where the subject is **plural**, the verb should also be **plural**.
 
 
• Example: ***They** **were** the only ones who knew the answer*.
